item.title: Version 3.5.2
item.description: - **Update notice:** when a new version is ready, Rostrum tells you with a small popover from the menu bar and a bar at the bottom of the window. Nothing installs until you click Update. Rostrum now checks every 6 hours. - **Free semester of Pro:** try Pro free for 4 months from rostrumstudy.app, no card needed. When a trial ends, Rostrum says so once; everything free keeps working, including AI with your own key, and nothing is deleted. - **Buy Pro:** Settings ▸ Plan has a Buy link.
